cp_metrics.target_channel: L/R must be declared from the frozen champion convention; no handedness sign reinterpretation.

input_rule: Use direct complex Ex/Ey or direct per-case coherency/Stokes and power at the same output plane; no derived plane-wave transfer multiplication.

lp_metrics.useful_power: S0 times the declared collection/target-output factor, never an invented absolute LEE.

normalization_and_prohibitions: MDC r12_normalized_output is relative spectral shape, not absolute emitted power.
Do not multiply MDC spectrum by plane-wave transmission to claim integrated output.
Do not average DoLP values in place of coherency integration.
No historical constant-index result can substitute for Native-M1 direct output.

stokes_from_coherency: S3 = -2 Im(Cxy) under the project convention
